title: When AI Starts Building Better AI

scenes.title: THE FEEDBACK LOOP
scenes.subtitle: When AI helps build the next generation of AI
scenes.narration: Imagine a research team trying to build a more capable artificial intelligence system. Now imagine the tools helping that team write code, run experiments, analyze results, and solve technical problems are AI systems themselves. Each generation could help researchers build the next one faster. But how much of this is already happening? And are we approaching a point where AI development accelerates beyond the pace people can comfortably understand? A new assessment inside Anthropic offers an unusually close look, with important caveats.

scenes.title: INSIDE THE INVESTIGATION
scenes.subtitle: METR assessment | 12 August – 29 October 2026
scenes.narration: The nonprofit research organization METR conducted an eleven week assessment of Anthropic's artificial intelligence research and development. Researchers examined internal measurements covering model training, reinforcement learning, computing resources, and benchmark performance. They also interviewed staff and reviewed analyses of how AI tools were affecting research. This matters because the public usually sees the finished model. The experiments, failed approaches, and engineering decisions that produce it are mostly hidden inside the laboratory. METR received unusual access, but much of the evidence it considered most informative was redacted before publication.
